summary: Master the art of data exploration with our EDA Training Course. Gain hands-on experience in analyzing and visualizing data for informed decision-making.
lede: Exploratory data analysis (EDA) teaches data professionals to inspect datasets and check data quality before reporting or modeling. They practice profiling datasets, examining distributions and relationships, and identifying outliers and missing values with statistical methods and visualizations. They also explore data transformations and build reproducible reports and dashboards to communicate findings.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals who need to extract meaningful insights from complex datasets and validate data quality before reporting or modeling.
modules: Exploratory Data Analysis Foundations and Frameworks
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of basic statistics (mean, median, standard deviation) and introductory experience with Python® programming, specifically familiarity with basic data structures like lists and dictionaries. Prior exposure to Excel for data analysis is helpful but not required.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
